newsitem.title: FINLAND: Helsinki up nearly three pct on Nokia strength.
newsitem.headline: Helsinki up nearly three pct on Nokia strength.

text.p: A very strong showing in bourse bellwhether Nokia boosted the HEX index nearly three percent to another all-time high close in very lively trade on Wednesday, and brokers said market sentiment remained bullish.
The HEX index closed up 2.87 percent at 2,616.71 -- a new all-time high for the third straight session -- with total volume a mighty 800 million markka for Helsinki.

Nokia made up over half total trade, rising at the open and soon topping its higher overnight Wall Street close to end up 18.5 markka or almost seven percent at 290.50 after touching an intrasession high of 291.50.

After reports of analyst enthusiasm for Nokia during the day news of a very bullish price target from Smith Barney, envisaging a rise of about 70 percent in Nokia's ADR price to $99 dollars in 12 months, offered a late boost.

Nokia, which makes up about a third of the weight of the HEX index, has risen almost 10 percent since the beginning of the year. It was the main attraction but brokers said a January shopping spree continued elsewhere too.
"This is on a broad front," one said. "Small investors are buying anything that moves."
